text: G3 complete. The experimental state stores one authoritative forward residual plus exact affine per arm; plus/minus right-composition signs, boundary extension, swap, and positive-Jacobian contracts pass. Geometry hard failures are typed incremental/accumulated Jacobian verdicts only. Damping, stepScale, and squarings respond exclusively to objective, Jacobian-failure, and integration-error observations respectively; inverse drift only requests cache refresh; all controls/retries are capped and traced. Residual inverses are refined coarse-to-fine for export, exact affine inverses are composed outside refinement, percentile/max physical and voxel errors are reported, and impossible tolerances fail typed. Smooth fixture p99/max residual error is about 0.004/0.00413 mm and endpoint max round trip below 0.0075 mm. Full registration JVM and JS suites pass 59/59.
